label: positive
description: RC-EXTRACT1, measured on Aave v2 UniswapLiquiditySwapAdapter.executeOperation. At N-1, executeOperation performs its own arithmetic through SafeMath.add(). At N, executeOperation's own body is UNCHANGED except that the call site now targets a new internal helper, _swapLiquidity, which performs the same update with a plain `+` and no SafeMath. Pragma stays ^0.7.6 in both commits.
why_labeled: The checked-arithmetic call was not removed, it was EXTRACTED: executeOperation itself has no diff in its own arithmetic (it never touched `amounts` directly at N-1 either, by the time this shape is reached in the real Aave commit) and a same-function comparison finds nothing. Rule 4 must therefore evaluate reachability: executeOperation reached a checked call at N-1 (directly) and reaches NONE at N (only _swapLiquidity's plain addition), so the arithmetic that used to be guarded is now unprotected under a pragma that gives no compiler checks. CONFIRMED. Pair-mate of N4x-01, which is diff-identical except the helper KEEPS the SafeMath call - the only fixture that proves the fix does not fire on every extraction, only on the ones that drop protection.
